title: Wide term witnessing truncation error
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the Boolean cube, and let $w$ be a nonnegative integer. If, at some input $x$, the formula and the formula obtained by deleting all terms of width greater than $w$ have different values, then $\varphi$ contains a term of width greater than $w$ that evaluates to true at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube.
There is an input $x$ at which the original and width-truncated formulas differ.
